alerts.title: Abdominal Pain with TDF
alerts.message: Guidelines state TDF can cause abdominal pain. Patient reports abdominal pain. TDF is a known cause, but non-drug causes like infection should also be considered. Lab tests like LFTs and RFTs are recommended.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor and consider LFTs and RFTs
